podcast.body: This song, referred to as "Big Time Sensuality," is featured on Björk's 1993 solo record, "Debut." It exemplifies her eclectic and experimental style, contributing to her role in keeping music innovative and fresh. "Bjork, in big time, sensuality from her debut solo record, confusingly called debut, which it really wasn't."
